allocation_robustness.note: After C1-C3 corrections, aggregate spread EXCEEDS aggregate charity, so the per-entity clip no longer manufactures the gap; the adversarial charity-weighted allocation leaves a positive floor (raw-gap level, before overlap/recoverability).

overlap_method.issue_13: COMPUTED via direct CCN join: sum over hospitals that fail #13's community-benefit test of min(i19_gap, i13_gap). C5: subtracted at FULL min() value, NOT down-scaled by #13's survival fraction (which had inflated #19's booked figure).
overlap_method.issue_17: COMPUTED RECONCILIATION: #17 already removed the 340B-acquired Part B share (0.35) entirely and reserved it for #19. #17 books the INTERNATIONAL gap on NON-340B units; #19 books the DOMESTIC 340B spread on 340B units. Additive at the dollar level. Residual is a 5% buffer.
overlap_method.issue_4: PBM-affiliated chains (CVS/ESI/Optum ~34% of CP throughput) collect contract-pharmacy fees partly counted in #4's PBM total. 5% of raw gap.

params.discount_basis: paid * d/(1-d) on DISCOUNTED acquisition price (C2)

allocation_sensitivity.note: weight not usable from public cache (see methodology)

air340b_reconciliation.note: AIR340B's $44.1B is the SELL-SIDE margin (reimbursement received minus 340B acquisition cost); our net spread is the BUY-SIDE acquisition discount minus CP fees. On the corrected WAC basis our gross discount (~$66.6B whole-program) is consistent with IQVIA, and the DSH net-spread reconciles to the same order of magnitude as AIR340B's profit. Our central charity (~$16B, 38% real 990 coverage + S-10 fallback) is close to AIR340B's $18.5B Schedule-H financial-assistance figure, resolving the prior ~2x charity divergence.

limitations.allocation_not_measurement: Per-entity 340B spend is ALLOCATED, not measured. The allocation-proxy sensitivity (beds/uniform/charity-weighted) is a first-class output (allocation_sensitivity.csv); even the adversarial charity-weighted allocation leaves a positive floor because aggregate spread exceeds aggregate charity. HRSA does not publish per-entity purchase volumes; OPAIS bulk export requires an authenticated interactive session. Data-partner CTA: Apexus PVP per-entity disclosure.
limitations.discount_basis_wac: Gross discount = paid * d/(1-d) on the DISCOUNTED acquisition price (C2 correction), anchored to IQVIA WAC list value $147.8B and gap $66.4B (44.9% off WAC). Per-NDC ceiling prices are gated; bands 0.38/0.49.
limitations.charity_scope: Central charity = Schedule H line 7a financial assistance at cost where a REAL IRS-990 match exists (38% of the universe), else HCRIS S-10 charity-care-at-cost. The pure-7a-only series (narrowest) and the broad Schedule H basket (generous) bracket the band. Bad-debt-inclusive uncompensated care is NOT used in the central (C3 correction).
limitations.universe_proxy: DSH universe = nonprofit + government SHORT-TERM ACUTE hospitals (CCN 0001-0879/1225-1299/1300-1399; psych/LTCH/rehab removed, children's moved to a separate 340B category; C1). For-profit excluded as statutorily ineligible. Anchored to AHA 2022 (1,586 tax-exempt 340B hospitals).
limitations.dsh_share_staleness: The 78% DSH sub-share is 2022-vintage applied to the 2024 $81.4B program. Banded 0.74/0.78/0.82 in the sensitivity grid.

data_partner_cta: The lead ask is Apexus 340B Prime Vendor Program per-entity purchase data, which would replace the allocation with measured per-hospital 340B purchase volume. Secondary asks: per-NDC ceiling prices (HRSA, gated), per-entity contract-pharmacy fee disclosure (340B Health member survey), and state APCD per-prescription spread observation.
vs_target: central $10.33B vs $10.0B scoping target. Computed bottom-up, reported as-is, NOT tuned.
